Seamaster Planet Ocean 600M

Dive · 39.5mm, 42mm, 43.5mm, 45.5mm · 600m · automatic · 2005–2026

The Omega Seamaster Planet Ocean 600M is a line of professional-grade dive watches known for its robust build, high water resistance, and advanced mechanical movements. Signature design cues include a helium escape valve, a unidirectional rotating bezel, and broad arrow hands.

The story

Launched in 2005, the Planet Ocean was introduced as a more technically advanced and robust option within the Seamaster family, with a water resistance of 600 meters. The first generation used a modified ETA-based Calibre 2500 with a Co-Axial escapement. A significant update came in 2009 with the introduction of a limited edition model featuring a Liquidmetal and ceramic bezel, a technology that was later integrated into the second generation in 2011. This second generation also saw the introduction of the in-house Co-Axial Calibre 8500 and new case materials like titanium. The third generation, launched in 2016, brought Master Chronometer certification with the Calibre 8900 series, offering enhanced anti-magnetism. A fourth generation was introduced in 2025, featuring a slimmer case design.
